mechanism: Solomon sparse integer class head with first-token shortcut removed and balanced wrong-operation distractors per input. The model could not route five operations from held-out sentence-template families after the shortcut was removed.
summary: EXP-008 kept the same model geometry and training rule as EXP-007 but changed the information surface: balanced distractors, normalized-surface disjoint templates, and absent operation identifiers. The model failed to reach the 900,000 ppm overall gate on all three seeds.
lineage_note: An 8,192-feature perceptron with hashed n-gram features cannot route compositional operations without the first-token shortcut. A future attempt needs a different representation or architecture, not more features.
